profile.headline: SDE @ Ciena
profile.summary: SDE in PON (Passive Optical Network) research and development division at Ciena.

positions.title: SVT/PV Engineer Routing/IP 2
positions.description:
- Architected and built internal Python-based PON device SDK implementing optical network management protocols, including OMCI, DPoE and proprietary Ciena μOLT management protocol. Enables efficient communication and control of ONU/ONTs and Ciena μOLTs with extensive use in internal tooling, developer workflows and thousands of automated tests.

- Spearheaded crucial hardware (FPGA) and firmware integration testing of first-of-its-kind 25 gigabit PON bridge ASIC, identifying critical defects before chip tape-out.

- Designed and developed robust scalable and modular test automation framework enabling seamless integration across multiple products, and reducing lines of code per test suite by up to 80%

- Led the transition from bare-metal lab machines to a virtualized environment using Proxmox, streamlining deployment and configuration through Ansible and Cloud-Init to enhance efficiency, scalability, and consistency.
positions.insights: Scapy, Linux System Administration and +10 skills

positions.title: SVT/PV Engineer Routing/IP 1
positions.description: Develop and maintain automated tests for core features of Ciena MicroPlug OLT including DBA (Dynamic Bandwidth Allocation), I2c communication, and Layer 2 switching.
positions.insights: Gigabit-Capable Passive Optical Network (GPON), TestRail and +1 skill

positions.title: A/V Stagehand
positions.description: Assisted in audio and video setup for conventions such as Intel Innovation 2022 and music acts including The Weeknd and Elton John.

positions.title: Information Security Intern
positions.description:
• Automated user provisioning tasks by leveraging Powershell Active Directory module.
• Monitored logs and analyzed potential threats using Proofpoint, LogRhythm, and Rapid7.
• Secretary of Risk Management Committee.

honors.title: Teamwork Award
honors.description: “The last couple of months the team has had to juggle many projects. Eric was instrumental in keeping Bixby and OLT firmware testing moving forward. His attention to detail and follow up are a great asset to the team.”

honors.title: Innovation Award
honors.description: “Thank you Eric for always stepping up and finding solutions for our team when we have problems.  Your ability to debug, diagnose and provide solutions has been a real asset to the group. The team really appreciates what you do for us.”

projects.title: Home Lab
projects.description: Built and manage a highly resilient Linux-based server hosting self-hosted services (e.g., media streaming, file sharing, and home automation) with ZFS for data integrity and Docker containers behind a reverse proxy, providing secure out-of-band access to 10+ users with 99% uptime.

projects.title: PackPlan
projects.description: Cross-platform mobile application for collaboratively planning outdoor trips with friends in real-time. Implemented using Flutter SDK, Firebase Realtime Database, Google Places API, and OpenWeatherMap API.
